reason: The README primarily describes visual customization: importing images to generate application themes and backgrounds, with an additional Windows desktop pet controlled through host APIs and PowerShell/WPF.

summaries.zh: 导入图片生成应用主题与背景，并可选配由宿主控制的 Windows 桌面宠物。
summaries.en: Import images to generate application themes and backgrounds, with an optional Windows desktop pet controlled through the host.

capabilities: Imports PNG, JPG, and WebP images into a browser-local gallery
Extracts image colors to generate light and dark theme tokens
Applies uploaded images as page backgrounds with opacity and blur controls
Launches and stops a topmost desktop pet through host APIs and PowerShell/WPF
Polls a host endpoint to reflect agent activity in the desktop pet
Persists gallery and settings in browser localStorage
